turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on irregular past verbs?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Irregular verbs have special past forms and do not end in -ed. Examples: go - went, buy - bought, see - saw. A common mistake is saying "goed" instead of "went".

Exercise 1. Write the past form of 'have': Yesterday I ___ a big lunch.
